items.name: voice/en/m05_arrival/roofs
items.text:
The roofs of Low Water, ten minutes later.

The sweep holds the streets. The only way to the freight platform is over the tanks and down the tram trench, and Splice is still in the workshop.

Get the rest out.
items.title: No Forwarding Address: roofs

items.name: voice/en/l05_l06/carrier
items.text:
Mara found one carrier who would come.

The freight platform falls behind. Low Water stays below.
items.title: Common carrier: departure

items.name: voice/en/l05_l06/records
items.text:
The transfer records name the lunar custody depot.

The missing from Low Water are already on their way there.
items.title: Common carrier: records

items.name: effects/grenade_bounce
items.prompt: One small heavy steel hand grenade bouncing once against worn concrete, short dry metal thunk and tiny scrape, very compact transient followed by quiet air, close clean recording, no speech, no music, no weapon shot, no ringing tone
items.title: Grenade: dry bounce

items.name: effects/grenade_blast
items.prompt: One compact hand grenade explosion, dry sharp crack with low impact and a brief gritty concrete debris tail, game combat sound with clear attack and quick decay, no ringing ears, no voice, no music, no cinematic swell, no long reverb
items.title: Grenade: compact blast
